propositions: Author a new Pass-1 overlay prompt that applies lockset-first concurrency analysis: identify shared mutable resources accessed without consistent serialization discipline across sibling accessors

The rubric must enforce the quartet bright-line: shared resource, concurrent executors (spawn/entry cited), interleaving window (quoted read+write), and concrete harm; findings without all four elements are invalid

Guard-suppression rules must be disposition-aware: suppress only when the guard prevents the harm; defer TOCTOU on security boundary to security overlay, and defer load-only concurrency harm to performance overlay

The prompt must be structurally valid (frontmatter keys, rubric sections present), inert until registered by dependent story errable-tricksome-ape, and testable by structural grep and existing test suite
